title: Badge component reuse in common
answers: Where should new badge types be implemented in mitmweb?
How are method and status badges styled in the UI?
Should I create a dedicated component in common for a new badge?
body:
Components under `web/src/js/components/common` should remain generic presentation wrappers rather than domain-specific badges.
Instead of adding specialized badge components like `MethodBadge` to `common/`, reuse `web/src/js/components/common/Badge.tsx:Badge` and attach specialized CSS classes (e.g. `.method-badge` or `.status-badge` from `web/src/css/badges.less`).
Flow-specific value formatting and badge color classification belong in helper functions such as `web/src/js/flow/utils.ts:statusClass` or column renderers.
applies: web/src/js/components/common/Badge.tsx and badge styling in mitmweb
says: HTTP method and response status tags look inconsistent across different traffic detail views.
Request method labels should share the same styling as status code pill tags.
Add consistent color coded status badges for traffic flows in the web interface.
Standardize the appearance of protocol badges and method labels across the UI.
